title: Survival Countdown: Designing Time Pressure and the 'Final 10 Seconds' Effect
subtitle: Analyze time pressure mechanics focusing on non-malicious dynamic curves and forgiveness windows. Deep dive into the 'Final 10 Seconds' effect to reveal how countdowns alter risk-reward ratios, driving players toward aggressive decisions in high-stakes endings, providing empirical strategies for building urgency in action-dodging levels.

breakdown.title: How to Implement Time Pressure Without Being 'Malicious'
bullets: Provide planable resources: extra-time items, shortcuts, risky routes
Make failure reasons readable: 1 second short vs. completely hopeless creates vastly different experiences

breakdown.title: The Final 10 Seconds Effect
bullets: Turn audio/visual cues into rituals: heartbeats, flashing, warning text
Increase rewards or grant burst items in the final 10 seconds to encourage risky decisions
Allow 'lenient judgment': slightly widen the finish line to reduce frustration

breakdown.title: Curve Recommendations
bullets: Dedicate the first 60% of time to exploration and learning
Gradually increase pressure in the next 30% (enemies, obstacles, path changes)
Use the final 10% for a single goal: create the climax
